rows.name: Lao Delights
rows.notes: side: windward. The Plenty of Aloha organizer page lists Lao Delights as a Windward Mall Market vendor, but the page is undated. I found no own Instagram, Facebook or website. 'Aloha Delights' (a Colorado baker) and Khao and Papas are different businesses and were not used.

rows.name: Las Borinquenas
rows.notes: side: leeward_ewa (from the seed; not verified). No source found for this exact business. A 'Sabor Boricua' listing in Kapolei and a 'Korean Puerto Rican' truck in a directory appeared, but neither matches the name, so I did not use them.

rows.name: Ma'Ona
rows.notes: side: town. This is Ma'Ona Musubi at 921 Alakea St, Honolulu. Its Facebook page lists maonamusubi.com. The Marketspread organizer listing (https://marketspread.com/vendor/32033/maona-musubi-dba-aino-llc/) shows it as a vendor under Aino LLC in Honolulu 96813. The Facebook post I could see is from July 2022. A review-site title suggested it may be closed, but I can't use that source, so still_active is unknown. No Instagram found. Ma'ona Lunch Counter (@maonafood) is in Keaau/Hilo on Hawaiʻi Island and was excluded.

rows.name: Maguro Brothers
rows.notes: side: town. The seed says Central, but sources place Maguro Brothers in Kekaulike Market (Chinatown) and on Nāhua St in Waikīkī. The Instagram handle comes from the site's own sameAs link. The site tells visitors to follow on Instagram. A 2020 blog says to check Instagram for hours. I couldn't confirm current operating status, and no Facebook page was found.

rows.name: Na Mea 'Ono
rows.notes: side: windward (from the seed; not verified). Only 'He Mea 'Ono', a Kaneohe Hawaiian food spot, appeared. The name differs, so I did not assume it is the same business. No own accounts found.

rows.name: Neha Kitchen
rows.notes: side: central (from the seed). The listed locations are Waipahu, Waikele Center and Waianae, which could also read as leeward_ewa. The business is Neha's Kitchen, a Nepali food vendor. Its own site names Instagram @nepalifood808 for menu and pop-up dates. The site footer says 2023, and a Honolulu Magazine feature is about 2.3 years old, so current status is unconfirmed. The site has a Facebook link but gives no URL, so Facebook is null. Other 'Neha's Kitchen' Instagram accounts (@nehakitchen26, @neha_s_kitchen, @neha.kitchen) are unrelated recipe accounts.

rows.name: O-I-DE Kitchen
rows.notes: side: town. Aloha State Daily (April 2025) reports a new bento shop at 212 Merchant St, Honolulu, with Instagram @o.i.de_kitchen. It was run by the team from the closed Okonomiyaki Chibo. Stated hours were weekdays 11 a.m.–2:30 p.m. at the time. I found no newer news, and no own website or Facebook page.

rows.name: Ono Viet
rows.notes: side: leeward_ewa. The seed says Windward, but the Marketspread vendor listing places Ono Viet in Ewa Beach. It sells spring and summer rolls, bánh mì, Vietnamese iced coffee and tanghulu. A Star-Advertiser piece dated 28 Oct 2026 lists Ono Viet at a Waipahu event with spring rolls, banh mi and Thai tea, so it appears active. No own Instagram, Facebook or website found.

rows.name: Saap Saap Hawaii
rows.notes: side: town. Saap Saap HI is a Lao and matcha mobile cafe run by Rocky and Tamara Chandara. Hawaii News Now (May 2026) says it is at UH Mānoa Food Truck Row on weekday mornings and at the Pearlridge night market most Saturdays, 5–9 p.m. Plenty of Aloha also lists it as a Kaimuki Market vendor. I saw a Square site only through a review-site listing, so I left website null. I could not find a verified Instagram or Facebook handle. Saap Rai (Chinatown) is a different business.

rows.name: Sama Sama Hawaii
rows.notes: side: leeward_ewa. Sama Sama is a Filipino-inspired boba truck and cafe, established 2021 by Lalaine Ignao and Eric Ganding. Hawaii News Now (Oct 2024) places a cafe at Leeward Community College and a downtown Honolulu location at 1102 Bishop St. The website domain comes only from third-party listings and I didn't check the site itself. The UH Mānoa dining page lists a Wednesday 10am–2pm slot at Food Truck Row but is undated. No Instagram or Facebook handle was confirmed.

rows.name: Seven Brothers (At the Mill)
rows.notes: side: north_shore. The location is at the Kahuku Sugar Mill, 56-565 Kamehameha Hwy, Kahuku. The website domain comes from a Waze listing, which also gives hours of Mon–Sat 11:00–21:00; I didn't verify the site directly. A KITV article (about 28 days old) quotes a Seven Brothers general manager in a North Shore Huakaʻi story, but it doesn't clearly name the Kahuku 'At the Mill' location, so still_active stays null. No own Instagram or Facebook found.

rows.name: Smash Lemons
rows.notes: side: leeward_ewa. The Eventeny organizer page for Smash Lemons LLC lists it as home-based in Waianae and as a vendor at Christmas On The Avenue (Waianae, 13 Dec 2025). Whether this Smash Lemons LLC is the vendor in the directory is unconfirmed. A third-party map listing shows a Waipahu address (94-849 Lumiaina St). No own accounts found.

rows.name: Sou's Thai
rows.notes: side: town. The Hawaii Farm Bureau page says Sou's Thai is at the Manoa Marketplace Farmers' Market on Sundays only. That page is about 2.7 years old, so current status is unconfirmed. A 'Sou's Thai Kitchen' listing at 2851 E Manoa Rd was not tied to this vendor, so I did not use it. No own accounts found.

rows.name: Str'Eats of Aloha
rows.notes: side: town. The seed says Central, but its Facebook page lists 111 Sand Island Access Rd, Honolulu, and the truck travels the island for events. The Instagram handle @streats_of_aloha comes from a 2022 Star-Advertiser article, which says to check social media for locations. Orders are placed by text (808-763-6275) or social media, so there is no order URL. Current activity is unconfirmed. No own website found.

rows.name: Sugar Mami
rows.notes: side: unclear (the seed says Windward but I couldn't verify it). I ran out of searches before looking up this vendor, so nothing was checked or found.
